tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window behind every panel. Panels float on it with a 6px gap.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: sidebar, editor, terminal panes. The brand's Black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Pane headers, cards, menus and the active tab on `surface`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, inputs, unselected pills and chips.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything on `control`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed guide lines, count-badge rings, the empty-state dot matrix.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and on `purple`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `control` (5.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Idle status marks, disabled icons and placeholder text. 3.5:1 on `surface`: marks and placeholders only, never body copy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `ink`, `yellow` and `orange` fills: the selected pill, attention chips.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary buttons, the focused pane ring, the working state. Fill only; `ink` on it is 5.9:1.

tokens.name: purple-text
tokens.usage: Purple as text or a thin mark on dark grounds (6:1 on `surface`), where `purple` itself is too dark.

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Third stop of the brand gradient; never on its own.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: First stop of the brand gradient, and the 'your turn' state: an agent finished and waits for your next prompt.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Needs you now: a permission prompt or a question. The loudest colour in Saturn; nothing else uses it.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: An agent stopped on an error (rate limit, crash). Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Working: Claude is thinking or running tools.

tokens.name: status-needs-you
tokens.usage: Needs you: a permission prompt or a question is open.

tokens.name: status-your-turn
tokens.usage: Your turn: the turn finished; Claude waits for a prompt.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error: the turn failed.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Idle: a plain shell, or Claude ready with no turn started.

tokens.name: term-black
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI black; matches `surface`.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI red.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI green (diff additions, passing tests).

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI yellow.

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI blue.

tokens.name: term-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI magenta; the brand purple lifted for text.

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI cyan.

tokens.name: term-white
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI white and default foreground.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans Variable", "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and onboarding only. Light weight, as in the brand's headings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Project name at the top of the sidebar; dialog titles.

styles.name: pane-title
styles.usage: Terminal tab and pane names, editor tab names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text: tree rows, menus, settings.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines: branch names, paths, timestamps, in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Panel padding where children touch the edge (radius-lg − 4 = radius-md); gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on `ground`, and between grid cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane header padding; gap between pills.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding; tree row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state and dialog section gaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and anything nested 4px inside a `radius-md` element (10 − 4), or 8px inside a panel (14 − 8).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, inputs, tabs and tree rows: anything nested 4px inside a panel (14 − 4).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and terminal panes: the squircle the brand is built on, sized for dense UI. Pad 4px for `radius-md` children, 8px for `radius-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large empty-state tiles. Pad 12px so the controls inside take `radius-md` (22 − 12).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Segmented pills and count badges. A pill inside a pill stays a pill.

radius.note: Nested corners: inner radius = outer radius - padding. The steps are chosen so the common nestings land on a token.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and the quick-open palette above the grid.

tokens.name: glow-focus
tokens.usage: The focused pane: one at a time.

tokens.name: glow-needs-you
tokens.usage: A pane that needs you and has not been looked at since. Wins over `glow-focus`.

tokens.name: glow-your-turn
tokens.usage: A pane whose turn finished and has not been looked at since.
